caption: The drawing depicts a single sculpted figure of a dog standing in profile facing to the left. The dog's body is colored in various shades of brown, with a smooth texture along its hindquarters and upper back, while its head, front legs, and part of its body are covered in a criss-cross patterned texture resembling a decorative or protective covering. The tail and ears have a similar textured pattern. The dog stands on a rectangular base that is green with brown tonal shading. The claws on the paws are defined in dark brown or black. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, providing no additional context or scenery. There is a small, subtle signature in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Poodle
